scripts.prisma:generate: pnpm run prisma:build && pnpm exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:push: pnpm run prisma:build && pnpm exec prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate
scripts.prisma:push:force: pnpm run prisma:build && pnpm exec prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss --skip-generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: pnpm run prisma:build && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --name init --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate:create: pnpm run prisma:build && pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --create-only --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:studio: pnpm run prisma:build && pnpm exec prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
